name: workos-audit
description: Query WorkOS audit logs and emit Claude Code lifecycle events to WorkOS.

api_key.title: WorkOS API key
api_key.description: Optional WorkOS server API key. Leave blank to use `workos auth login` / the active WorkOS CLI environment.

organization_id.title: WorkOS organization ID
organization_id.description: Optional WorkOS organization ID that owns the audit logs. Leave blank to find/create Audit Log Harness automatically.

action_prefix.title: Action prefix
action_prefix.description: Optional audit action prefix. Leave blank for claude.

actor_id.title: Actor ID
actor_id.description: Optional actor ID override for emitted events. Leave blank to use the OS user.

actor_type.title: Actor type
actor_type.description: Optional actor type override. Leave blank for user.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional context location. Leave blank for claude-code.

user_agent.title: User agent
user_agent.description: Optional context user agent. Leave blank for claude-code-workos-audit/1.

recording_enabled.title: Record audit events
recording_enabled.description: Set to false (or no/off/0) to disable recording — useful for query-only Cloud sessions. Leave blank or true to record.
